name: navbar-gooey-bloom
title: Navbar Gooey Bloom
description: A glass navbar whose hover highlight is liquid: a lime pool stretches from link to link with a droplet dragging behind, while the label inverts to ink. Menus swell out of a drop into one gooey panel that leans toward its trigger and morphs between layouts, and inside it a lime blob flows from icon to icon.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/navbar-gooey-bloom
Pass `menus` (a `label` plus `columns` and an optional `feature`, or just an `href` for a plain link) and put your page inside as `children`. The goo filter is generated per instance, so several bars can share a page.
